8HFI · CRYO-EM STRUCTURE OF HUMAN NOREPINEPHRINE TRANSPORTER NET IN THE

Did not pass calibration: ρ = 0.13 (95% CI: -0.16–0.41; n = 57; Ki, CHEMBL853189). Vina's ranking cannot be distinguished from chance on this panel.

Crystal pose reproduced in 3 of 5 seeds (RMSD ≤ 2 Å)

Measured with exhaustiveness 8, 9 poses and seed 42. Not measured with other parameters.

The receptor was docked without the deposited ions (preparation removes them). Vina has no electrostatic term; the calibration was measured under these conditions.

The panel is almost entirely one analogue series: ρ describes how it ranks compounds of that series, not structurally diverse ligands.

The assay conditions (pH, temperature, radioligand) are not documented in the sources consulted; the correlation is within a single assay.

Top-1 RMSD by seed: 0.6, 0.5, 4.1, 0.6, 3.7 Å.

Sealed experiment: CAL-8HFI-01 (2026-10-09).

Blender and Molcy configuration
